question: Does the frozen CONE-S1 F2 Balanced Atmospheric Taper materially improve the exact PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 Stage incumbent when translated into the real five-Character composition without weakening texture, state readability, hierarchy or Kymaean identity?
single_variable: neutral Rest-state cone optical hierarchy: envelope width, taper, falloff, blur and vertical scale

full_stage_translation.translation_law: Each target cone uses the same F2 geometry relative to its incumbent floor anchor. Existing floor positions/social arc remain fixed; no Character receives a different optical family.

construction_method.source_beam_isolation: Per-cone source trapezoids are removed with bounded OpenCV Telea inpainting before the challenger field is applied.
construction_method.color_preservation: Each cone's positive source-light residual determines its existing RGB direction; no new hue or palette value is introduced.
construction_method.state_intensity_preservation: Per-cone source residual luminance above the floor is measured and used to scale the F2 field, preserving relative incumbent state intensity rather than assigning new state meaning.
construction_method.texture_preservation: Only bounded high-frequency source residual is reintroduced at fixed low weight; no new texture vocabulary is authored.
construction_method.floor_pool_preservation: Original incumbent floor pools are restored after beam construction using fixed feathered ellipses; F2 does not reopen floor-pool design.
construction_method.fixed_ui_preservation: Top shell, right rail, performance/history, creator-action bar and footer are pixel-identical to the incumbent.

rejected_attempts.reason: Perspective-warp residual produced a hard bright lower-cone V artifact and was rejected before evaluation.
Residual lower-cone geometry remained visible beneath the smooth field and was rejected before evaluation.

pixel_isolation_audit.interpretation: All differences are bounded to the five beam optical fields and their immediate upper/floor-adjacent atmosphere; no shell, rail, performance, action, footer, or lower-stage continuation surface is rewritten.

evaluation_criteria: F2 must strengthen Characters as inhabited volumes of light rather than theatrical fixtures or software objects.
F2 must preserve or improve five-Character readability and discrete one-cone-per-Character presence.
F2 must preserve the shared dark-floor ensemble relation without merging equal Characters into one luminous field.
F2 must not weaken the existing state hierarchy or make Selected/Opportunity/Speaking/Listening distinctions less legible in context.
F2 must preserve the incumbent texture vocabulary and causal-field character strongly enough that the Stage remains recognizably Kymaean rather than generic atmospheric spotlights.
F2 must not increase competition with Production/Scene context, performance text, creator controls or right-rail hierarchy.
F2 must preserve the context-agnostic background and must not imply new relationship, role, emotion, authority or ODR semantics.
Promotion requires a material net improvement over PKT-STAGE-CORE-02; parity or mixed tradeoff retains the incumbent.

decision_law.failure_consequence: If F2 fails integrated Stage criteria, retain PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 and close this F2 comparison without F2b, reroll or geometry retune in the same gate.
decision_law.promotion_consequence: If F2 materially improves the incumbent, promote only the optical successor; no palette, state, motion, texture-token or implementation authority is created.
